name: Equipment inventory (Hose)
description: Press [$[action_equipment_use]] to attach the hose to an unoccupied fluid hose anchor. Interacting with [$[action_interact_left]]/[$[action_interact_right]] on an occupied fluid hose anchor will retrieve the hose if the player has inventory space to hold it. If the hose contains water, press [$[action_equipment_secondary]] to toggle open the hose valve and allow the water to flow freely.
shortDescription: A large equipment storage unit containing 20m of fluid hosing.
